evidence.quote: To begin the discussion of regulatory reform, I will first explain my view that the imperative for financial regulatory reform has much deeper roots than the imprudent mortgage lending
the effect of new capital and liquidity requirements on lending, and thus on economic recovery and growth, must be carefully taken into account.
the reform process cannot be judged a success unless it substantially reduces systemic risk generally and, in particular, the too-big-to-fail problem.
